title: The return stroke retains changed thermal energy rather than resetting it
statement: Introduced coupled .25s forward/return dynamics include gas/wall energy, membrane elasticity, hysteresis, viscosity, ambient exchange and asymmetry boundary work. One cycle1.208402112uJ leaves1.114773745uJ thermal change and .093628379uJ ambient heat. One hundred same-stock cycles give .000120839081J head work, .000112823397J heat loss and .000008015684J final thermal energy, with both final temperatures retained. These are synthetic mechanical cycles, not physical retargeting life or total programmer energy.
